game.title: Mafia III
game.blurb: Action-adventure set in New Bordeaux, from Hangar 13, released 2016-10-06. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Lincoln Clay's story, mission by mission. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Rackets, Associates and Money
chapters.summary: Taking over rackets, informants and Racket Bosses, the associates' side-missions, underbosses and earning and spending money.

chapters.title: Driving and Police
chapters.summary: Speed, jumps, drifts, vehicle takedowns, police cars and police chases.

chapters.title: Combat and Weapons
chapters.summary: Takedowns, headshots, alligators, throwing knives, mines, traps, the dart gun, sniper support and bounty hunting.

chapters.title: Herbalism and the Grow House
chapters.summary: Herbalism levels, the Grow House, selling weed and Slim's re-election billboards.

chapters.title: Sammy's and the Cult
chapters.summary: Investigating the cult at Sammy's, the Places of Darkness, Bonnie Harless and renovating Sammy's.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 360430)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Mafia_III
Fandom (mafiagame.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://mafiagame.fandom.com/wiki/Mafia_III
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents are linked but none of its subpages exist. mafiagame.fandom.com answers the API, with about 79 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is Mafia III: Definitive Edition (360430), the only Steam store match; the Steam schema calls it "WHISKEY_DEV" (an internal codename). 32 of 85 Steam achievements are hidden and all sit in the main story chapter, but they come in four separate schema blocks: 15 at the top ("Before They Bury You" to "We Partners Now"), 4 among the racket ones ("We're in This Together", "Just You and Me", "Trust", "Family"; 2 to 22 percent, possibly endings), 8 just before the Grow House block ("Real Nice Time" to "Concerned Citizens") and 5 just before the dart gun and bounty block ("Creature of Habit" to "There Are No Dominos"). The last two blocks may belong to add-on content, but the data names no DLC, so they need checking. "Street Rocket" (50 km in the Samson Harrier) went to driving; proximity mines and vehicle traps went to combat.
